name: České státní svátky (multijazyčné, openpotato/OpenHolidays)
title: České státní svátky (multijazyčné, openpotato/OpenHolidays)
description: Public holidays of the Czech Republic as published by the OpenHolidays API and seeded from the openpotato/openholidaysapi.data monorepo. Each record carries a stable UUID, ISO start/end dates, year/month/day decomposition, Czech and English day-of-week labels, RegionalScope (always National for CZ), and parallel names in Czech (default), German, and English. Year span 2020–2030 (11 years). Complements the pre-existing canonical-pin cs-statni-svatky (vacanza algorithmic, CS/EN, 2020–2026, 91 records) and cs-statni-svatky-a-vyznamne-dny (vacanza algorithmic, CS/EN/SK/UK, 1952–2030, 794 records) by exposing the OpenHolidays editorial seed snapshot (CS/DE/EN, 2020–2030, annual upstream curation) with German translations. Useful for OpenHolidays-API-compatible consumers and for cross-checking the vacanza algorithmic output against the OpenHolidays editorial source.
